description: Paper pair trade: $200 long Nvidia and $200 short AMD, opened 2026-11-13 and closed 4 hours later. SPY recorded for context.

planned_exit.price_rule: open of the 1-minute bar starting at the exit time

costs: No commission. Borrow fee on the AMD short and bid/ask gaps are a few cents at most over 4 hours, so they are ignored.
realism_note: Most brokers only let you short whole shares and need a margin account, so a $200 AMD short (0.37 shares) is simulated pro rata.

result.note: Nvidia was flat (+0.08%) and AMD fell 1.61%, so nearly all the gain came from the short. No AMD-specific news for the day was found. Nvidia reports quarterly results on November 17, 2026.
